# Release Checklist

## Version/provenance

- [ ] Version updated
- [ ] Upstream base updated
- [ ] Patch inventory current
- [ ] Changelog complete

## Tests

- [ ] CPU/static tests
- [ ] GPU smoke matrix
- [ ] State-leak sequence
- [ ] Interrupt sequence
- [ ] Clean install
- [ ] Upgrade
- [ ] Rollback
- [ ] Soak

## Performance

- [ ] Wall timer validated
- [ ] Paired benchmark report
- [ ] Memory soak
- [ ] Compatible fallback

## Compliance

- [ ] License
- [ ] Credits
- [ ] Source link
- [ ] Dependency inventory
- [ ] Checksums

## Documentation

- [ ] Install
- [ ] Upgrade
- [ ] Rollback
- [ ] Known issues
- [ ] Support matrix
- [ ] Diagnostic instructions
